The Three Content Layers

Not all content deserves equal effort. The 10x PMM allocates time strategically across three layers:

⚡ Commodity

20%
AI-generated
Blog, social, email

🎯 Strategic

40%
Human-directed, AI-assisted
GEO articles, competitive

✨ Signature

40%
Entirely human
Keynotes, original POV

This lab analyzes your recent content and time allocation, then shows you:

  • Which pieces fall into each layer
  • Where your effort is misallocated
  • What should be automated vs. elevated
  • A 90-day reallocation plan
